newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Soccer-Zaire underdogs draw 2-2 with Zambia.
newsitem.headline: Soccer-Zaire underdogs draw 2-2 with Zambia.

text.p: Zaire shrugged off raging war in their vast Central African country and fought Zambia to a 2-2 draw in a World Cup qualifier in Harare on Wednesday.
Veteran striker Kenneth Malitoli put Zambia ahead with a low shot after 21 minutes.
Zaire, popularly known as the Leopards, hit back eight minutes later with a strike by Etienne Sunda which was cheered by about 20,000 fans, mostly Zimbabweans.
The Leopards, branded underdogs by media for the Africa group three qualifier for the World Cup in France in 1998, took the leas five minutes into the second half with a screamer from Epole Bazamba.
Zambian midfielder Andrew Tembo equalised nine minutes from time after Zambia piled on relentless pressure.

The game was played in Harare after the world's soccer body FIFA ruled that Kinshasa was unsafe for the Zambians in view of the war between President Mobutu Sese Seko's army and Laurent Kabila's rebels who now control nearly half the country.
